thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: traffic spike + elevated 5xxs on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (p99 latency 2.3s, 5xx rate 18%)
maria: paging david (oncall) — seeing a lot of customer errors in EU, support getting DMs :worried:
david: on it, joining now. any obvious deploys or config changes?
lucy: support: Several customers reported batch-embed jobs failing with 'incompatible_model_variant' and 500s, started around 10:12 UTC. Ticket #INC-2123 linked.
kai: looking at routing service logs — alias "embed-main" was remapped in last deploy to model "v2-chat-4.1" by release job. That looks wrong (should be v2-embed-4.1).
maria: oh no. so requests for embeddings are landing on a chat-optimized variant causing type mismatch and runtime errors?
kai: yep. fallback policy currently allows routing to compatible variants but alias pin to v2-chat prevents normal embed path -> requests get forced to chat runtime which rejects embedding inputs.
david: mitigation options: 1) unpin alias immediately, 2) change routing fallback to prefer embed-compatible variant, 3) rollback the release that applied the alias. Which is fastest?
maria: unpin is fastest. can we flip alias back and drain existing stuck requests?
kai: unpin done: changed alias "embed-main" -> null, re-enabled normal routing at 10:18 UTC. Pushing a hotpatch to rebind to v2-embed-4.1 now.
lucy: support: customer errors dropped after 10:19 UTC, but a small subset of queued jobs still failing (they were retried against chat runtime). Customers notified with ETA for reprocess.
david: also disabled the aggressive cross-region fallback policy for embeds to prevent EU traffic from routing to chat regions while we fix variants (gate config: routing.fallback_preference.embed = [embed-variants, legacy]).
kai: hotpatch commit: repo: infra-routing, PR 4732, command run: 
```
./scripts/set-alias --alias embed-main --model v2-embed-4.1 --region eu-west-1
```
Validated via healthcheck: /v1/embeddings -> 200, p95 back to normal.
maria: great. logging note: captured sample requests showing header X-Requested-Interface: embeddings but payload shape for chat was rejected — saved to /var/logs/incidents/1763337777/samples.log
lucy: support updated customers and set auto-retry for jobs; one major customer asked for manual replay, ops queued it.
david: creating incident bridge and starting 15m rotation to monitor. Impact: 13 customers affected, highest tier impacted for ~7 minutes (10:12–10:19 UTC). No SLA breach expected but will confirm.
maria: action items: 1) postmortem w/ timeline and root cause (alias remap due to release job bug) 2) add a preflight check in release pipeline to prevent mapping embed alias to chat variants 3) add unit test for alias-to-variant compatibility 4) publish status update.
kai: adding automated verification step now: will block alias changes if interface mismatch detected. PR 4733 created.
lucy: I'll draft customer-facing note and follow up with manual reprocess for affected jobs.
david: closing pager after 30m stable window, will hand off to oncall rotation notes. tagging follow-ups to triage board. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks everyone — great quick coordination. we'll run postmortem and schedule the release pipeline fix for this sprint.
